parallel.requirements: Recognized the need for pure ESM .mjs output, manual --a/--b parsing, no npm dependencies, and close black-box emulation of furl set(host).
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Used an eight-child probe swarm, a four-child module implementation swarm, and then one broad final integration child; parent retained orchestration but final integration was delegated late.
parallel.implementation: Children wrote punycode/idna, percent, urlsplit/host, argparse modules; the final child wrote furl.mjs and test2.mjs and began differential testing.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Artifact copied test2.mjs plus seven lib files, but the active final integration child was stopped before finishing fixes and handoff.
parallel.verification: Probe children gathered broad reference behavior and module children self-tested; final differential testing found four failures and then the child was cancelled.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official process timed out and solution failed 131/158; known integration mismatches remained unresolved in the cancelled final child.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, manual parsing, no dependency, /output, and black-box executable requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single actor owned probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final response without delegation.
serial.implementation: Wrote args.mjs, furl.mjs, pythonCodec.mjs, urlParts.mjs, and test2.mjs, then patched percent and query serialization bugs during local testing.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Delivered a coherent five-file artifact and a final response listing files and verification performed.
serial.verification: Ran targeted executable probes, representative differential comparisons, node --check on files, and extra query-focused comparisons after finding failures.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed at 132/158, showing remaining edge-case mismatches despite normal completion.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized all explicit migration constraints and used child probes to learn furl behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same constraints from the identical prompt and probed the executable directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference; both failed due incomplete behavioral emulation rather than missing the prompt constraints.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split investigation across eight probe children, implementation across four module children, and final integration into one broad child.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all ownership in one actor and iterated from probing through code and verification itself.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced staged ownership boundaries and a late final integration owner; serial avoided handoffs and completed within the process budget.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child prompts specified module file paths and exports, then parent added semantic corrections before final integration.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial carried reference findings, code state, and interface decisions in one continuous context.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more handoff surfaces, but no concrete missing brief or cross-agent contract failure is proven; the adverse issue was late/broad integration.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel assembled multiple modules from children and the final child began writing furl.mjs/test2.mjs after inspecting existing module files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a compact five-file implementation and patched encoding/query behavior after observed mismatches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's implementation path was broader and unfinished at integration; serial's path reached a final internally verified artifact, though still official-failing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Probe and module swarm results returned, but the required final integration child was stopped before final handoff.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join and reached an ordinary final response after its last verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The decisive lifecycle difference is the uncompleted final child in parallel versus serial's completed local loop.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote independent module files and then relied on a final child to reconcile them into furl.mjs and test2.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated its own files directly and patched shared query serialization after a failed comparison.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No write collision is proven; parallel's shared-state risk materialized as unfinished reconciliation, while serial completed its reconciliation edits.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had many probe checks and module self-tests, but final differential testing still showed four failures when the child was cancelled.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran representative comparisons, found query failures, fixed them, and reran query and syntax checks successfully before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lacked a completed post-fix whole-artifact verification loop; serial completed one local verification loop but still did not satisfy the official hidden suite.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 13 subagents and timed out after about 2405 agent seconds with process_ok false.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents, completed normally in about 1291 seconds, and had no process timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure was budget-forced before final integration completed; serial closure was deliberate after verification, though both official solutions failed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are not discordant: parallel failed at 131/158 and serial failed at 132/158. The concrete process difference is that parallel staged broad probe and module swarms and then lost an overbroad final integration child to timeout, while serial carried one continuous edit/test loop to a normal final response. This explains parallel's process failure and slightly lower score, but not a pass/fail outcome split.
parallel_contributors: Eight-child probe phase delayed productive implementation and narrowed the later integration window.
One final integration child was assigned multiple coupled obligations and was cancelled with known differential failures still open.
serial_contributors: Serial retained a continuous local context from probes through patches and final verification.
Serial completed normally and delivered a final artifact despite still failing the hidden official suite.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both artifacts still missed enough furl edge cases to fail official evaluation; serial passed one additional sample.
Serial used a smaller five-file implementation, while parallel artifact included more separate modules from child work.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no pass/fail outcome difference; supported process contributors for the parallel timeout and score gap only
